import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check git tags
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git tag -l | head -20")
print("Tags:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check commit history with dates
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git log --oneline --since='2024-01-01' | head -30")
print("\nRecent commits:", stdout.read().decode())
# Try checking recent commits to find better state
for commit in ["f69d89f8", "61b4d1a1"]:
    stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(f"cd /opt/areloria && git checkout {commit} 2>&1 | tail -3")
    stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria/server/dist/index.js 2>&1")
    exists = stdout.read().decode().strip()
    print(f"\nCommit {commit[:7]} dist: {exists}")
# Switch back to main
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git checkout main 2>&1 | tail -1")
client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
